parameters.name: Selection of command & frequency setpoint
parameters.description: Central switch to select control command source for inverter. Switches command and setpoint source between freely programmable BICO parameters and fixed command / setpoint profiles. Command and setpoint sources can be changed independently. The tens digit chooses the command source and the units digit chooses the setpoint source.
parameters.setting_conditions: Can be changed: T. Data set: CDS. Data type: U16. Access level: 4. Dependency: P0719 has higher priority than P0700 and P1000. If set to a value other than 0 (i.e. BICO parameter is not the setpoint source), P0844 / P0848 (first source of OFF2 / OFF3) are not effective; instead, P0845 / P0849 (second source of OFF2 / OFF3) apply and the . Notice: Particularly useful when e.g. changing command source temporarily from P0700 = 2. Settings in P0719 (contrary to P0700 settings) do not reset the digital inputs (P0701, P0702, ...)

modbus_registers.name: Supported Function Codes
modbus_registers.description: FC3 - Read Holding Registers (FC = 0x03); FC6 - Write Single Register (FC = 0x06); FC16 - Write Multiple Registers (FC = 0x10, page 139). Page 140: only FC3, FC6 and FC16 are supported. Read request of too many registers (>125) and write request of too many registers (>123) return exception code 03.
modbus_registers.evidence_quote: The SINAMICS V20 supports only three Function Codes.

modbus_registers.name: Mapping table (register sets)
modbus_registers.description: Registers map to specific parameters listed in the mapping table (Read/Write columns). No general rule for addressing arbitrary parameters as registers was found. Scaling: a parameter with decimal places is multiplied by the scaling factor in the table (page 145).

knowledge_items.title: Overcurrent
knowledge_items.description: Overcurrent (fault). • Motor power (P0307) does not correspond to the inverter power (r0206). • Motor lead short circuit • Earth faults r0949 = 0: Hardware reported r0949 = 1: Software reported r0949 = 22: Hardware reported
knowledge_items.cause: • Motor power (P0307) does not correspond to the inverter power (r0206). • Motor lead short circuit • Earth faults r0949 = 0: Hardware reported r0949 = 1: Software reported r0949 = 22: Hardware reported
knowledge_items.remedy: Check the following: • Motor power (P0307) must correspond to inverter power (r0206). • Cable length limits must not be exceeded. • Motor cable and motor must have no shortcircuits or earth faults. • Motor parameters must match the motor in use. • Value of stator resistance (P0350) must be correct. • Motor must not be obstructed or overloaded. • Increase ramp-up time (P1120) • Reduce starting boost level (P1312)
knowledge_items.evidence_quote: F1 Overcurrent

knowledge_items.title: Overvoltage
knowledge_items.description: Overvoltage (fault). • Main supply voltage too high • Motor is in regenerative mode r0949 = 0: Hardware reported r0949 = 1 or 2: Software reported
knowledge_items.cause: • Main supply voltage too high • Motor is in regenerative mode r0949 = 0: Hardware reported r0949 = 1 or 2: Software reported
knowledge_items.remedy: Check the following: • Supply voltage (P0210) must lie within limits indicated on rating plate. • Ramp-down time (P1121) must match inertia of load. • Required braking power must lie within specified limits. • Vdc controller must be enabled (P1240) and parameterized properly.

details.note: Note: Regenerative mode can be caused by fast ramp downs or if the motor is driven by an active load. Higher inertia requires longer ramp times; otherwise, apply braking resistor.

knowledge_items.evidence_quote: F2 Overvoltage

knowledge_items.title: Motor overtemperature
knowledge_items.description: Motor overtemperature (fault). Motor overloaded. This fault may occur if small motors (<= 250 W, 4- or 2-pole) are used and run at a frequency below 15 Hz, even though the motor temperature is within limits.
knowledge_items.cause: Motor overloaded. This fault may occur if small motors (<= 250 W, 4- or 2-pole) are used and run at a frequency below 15 Hz, even though the motor temperature is within limits.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check: load or load step too high?; motor nominal overtemperatures (P0626 - P0628) must be correct; motor temperature warning level (P0604) must match. knowledge_items.title: Configuration vector for the inverter failed
knowledge_items.description: Configuration vector for the inverter failed (fault). During startup the inverter checks if the configuration vector (SZL vector) has been programmed correctly and if hardware matches the programmed vector. If not the inverter will trip. • r0949 = 1: Internal failure - no hardware configuration vector available. • r0949 = 2: Internal failure - no software configuration vector available. • r0949 = 11: Internal failure - inverter code not supported. • r0949 = 12: Internal failure - software vector not possible.
knowledge_items.cause: During startup the inverter checks if the configuration vector (SZL vector) has been programmed correctly and if hardware matches the programmed vector. If not the inverter will trip. • r0949 = 1: Internal failure - no hardware configuration vector available. • r0949 = 2: Internal failure - no software configuration vector available. • r0949 = 11: Internal failure - inverter code not supported. • r0949 = 12: Internal failure - software vector not possible.
knowledge_items.remedy: Internal failures cannot be fixed. r0949 = 13 - Make sure the right power module is fitted.

details.note: Note: Fault needs power-cycle to be acknowledged. • r0949 = 13: Wrong power module fitted. • r0949 > 1000: Internal failure - wrong I/O board fitted.

For FC16 with a write the inverter cannot perform, other valid writes are still performed even though an exception response is returned.

The complete system consists of one pump controlled by the inverter and up to 2 further pumps / fans controlled from contactors or motor starters. The contactors or motor starter are controlled by digital outputs from the inverter. The diagram below shows a typical pumping system.

knowledge_items.title: Running the inverter in cavitation protection mode
knowledge_items.description: The cavitation protection will generate a fault / warning when cavitation conditions are deemed to be present. If the inverter gets no feedback from the pump transducer, it will trip to stop cavitation damage.

knowledge_items.title: Setting the dual ramp function
knowledge_items.description: The dual ramp function allows the user to parameterize the inverter so that it can switch from one ramp rate to another when ramping up or down to a setpoint. This may be useful for delicate loads, where starting to ramp with a fast ramp-up or ramp-down time may cause damage. The function works as follows: Ramp up: ● Inverter starts ramp-up using ramp time from P1120 ● When f_act > P2157, switch to ramp time from P1060 Ramp down: ● Inverter start
knowledge_items.evidence_quote: 5.6.3.16 Setting the dual ramp function

knowledge_items.title: Setting the DC coupling function

knowledge_items.title: Setting high/low overload (HO/LO) mode
knowledge_items.description: Setting HO/LO overload enables you to select the low-overload mode for pumps and fans, the most important target applications of SINAMICS V20 inverters. Low-overload mode can improve the rated output current of the inverter and therefore allows the inverter to drive motors of higher power. Typical application fields ● High overload: conveyors, agitators and centrifuges ● Low overload: pumps and fans Power ratings Rated power rating (HO mode) 18.5

notes: printed_page equals the PDF page index for all cited pages in this document (verified from page footers).
Evidence quotes were checked against pdftotext -raw output; parameter header lines join the Parameter/Range/Factory default/Can be changed/Scaling/Data set/Data type/Acc. Level columns.
Mapping table (pp.142-144) is column-scrambled in layout-mode extraction; raw-mode extraction gives row-aligned text which was used.
Register type 'Holding' is based on FC3 'Read Holding Registers' being the only read function code; data_type per register not stated.
No single 'stop method' parameter found: OFF1 (ramp, P1121), OFF2 (coast) and OFF3 (fast stop, P1135) are separate commands (section 5.6.2.1, p.83) selectable e.g. via P0701 settings.
No separate base frequency parameter found; rated motor frequency is P0310.

STW bit definitions taken from r0054 via r2036 note ('See r0054 for the bit field description'); ZSW bit definitions not attached because the manual links ZSW to r2018/P2019 only (P2019 default 52[0]); r0052 status word 1 bits are on p.157.
P2014 default 2000 ms from parameter list (p.230).
No selectable communication-loss reaction parameter found; WDOG TIME / WDOG ACTION registers (40001/40002) exist but values for WDOG ACTION are not described.
Parameters were extracted programmatically from the page text of chapter 7.2 (pp.151-280); param_group is the series band (hundreds) because the manual list is not divided into named groups.

Parameter default/range/can-be-changed/scaling/data set/data type/access level are the columns of the manual parameter list; importance tiers were assigned by the extractor from the parameter function.
Cn000-Cn011 connection macros and AP000-AP030 application macros are recorded as parameter-like records with their parameter presets in options.
Fault/alarm Cause and Remedy columns are separated heuristically from the table text (column order is lost in extraction); where a note column (r0949 values) exists it is stored in details.note.

Duplicate old mappings for the same parameter code (e.g. P1000, P1060, P1061, P1080, P1082, P2014) are merged into one record: the first mapping is kept as common_function, other mappings noted in equivalence_note.
